title: Both tabs show the same columns at the same widths
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure at least one term is deactivated; call it term A.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the column headings of the table on the Active tab.
  2. Click the "Inactive" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The table has one heading row reading Name, Due, Customers and Vendors, followed by a column with no heading that holds a "⋯" button on every row.
  • There is one table only (no separate sections for standard terms and the shop's own terms).

Step 2:

  • The Inactive tab shows term A in a table with the same four headings and the unlabeled "⋯" column, and every column is as wide as on the Active tab (the headings do not move when you switch tabs).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R4: “Each tab shows one table with the columns Name, Due, Customers, Vendors, and an unlabeled actions column holding the row's "⋯" menu (Story 2: Row menu actions). The columns keep the same widths on both tabs.”
  • S1-R14: “The Active tab lists every active term; the Inactive tab lists every deactivated term, standard and the shop's own, in the same columns and order.”
  • Key Decisions: “The page is one table with Active and Inactive tabs, the default picked from each row's menu.”
